He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane Green Wave]]. ==College career== Reynolds was named [[American Athletic Conference]] Most Improved Player as a junior.{{cite news |last1=Guillory |first1=William |title=Tulane F Cameron Reynolds named AAC's Most Improved Player |url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/article_ef35eac6-242c-58f5-b3cb-4c693232211a.html |access-date=November 23, 2020 |work=[[The Times-Picayune]] |date=March 9, 2017}} He averaged 17 points and 6.8 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last1=Dunnam |first1=Ted |title=Pearland's Reynolds signs 10-day contract with Minnesota Timberwolves |url=https://www.chron.com/neighborhood/pearland/sports/article/Pearland-s-Reynolds-signs-10-day-contract-with-13646884.php |access-date=November 23, 2020 |work=[[Houston Chronicle]] |date=February 26, 2019}} As a senior at Tulane, Reynolds averaged 15.1 points and 6.3 rebounds per game.{{cite news |title=Wolves sign forward Reynolds to 10-day contract |url=https://www.foxsports.com/north/story/wolves-sign-forward-reynolds-to-10-day-contract-022719 |access-date=November 23, 2020 |work=[[Fox Sports]] |date=February 27, 2019}} ==Professional career== ===Stockton Kings (2018–2019)=== After going undrafted in the [[2018 NBA draft]], Reynolds signed with the [[Stockton Kings]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He averaged 16.0 points per game in 33 appearances.{{cite web|title=Cameron Reynolds Signs 10-Day Contract With Minnesota Timberwolves |url=https://tulanegreenwave.com/news/2019/2/27/mens-basketball-cameron-reynolds-signs-10-day-contract-with-minnesota-timberwolves.aspx|first=|last=|website=tulanegreenwave.com|date=February 27, 2019|accessdate=March 3, 2019}} ===Minnesota Timberwolves (2019)=== Reynolds was signed to a 10-day contract by the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] on February 27, 2019.{{cite web|title=Timberwolves sign forward Cameron Reynolds to 10-day contract |url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-forward-cameron-reynolds-10-day-contract|first=|last=|website=[[NBA.com]]|date=January 8, 2019|accessdate=March 3, 2019}} He made his NBA debut on March 3, 2019, scoring two points in two minutes of play in a 121–135 loss to the [[Washington Wizards]]. On March 15, 2019, Reynolds signed a multi-year deal with the Timberwolves, but was later waived by the Timberwolves on June 28, 2019.{{cite web|title=TIMBERWOLVES WAIVE CAMERON REYNOLDS|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-waive-forward-cameron-reynolds|date=June 28, 2019|website=NBA.com|accessdate=June 28, 2019}} ===Milwaukee Bucks/Wisconsin Herd (2019–2020)=== Reynolds signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] on July 26, 2019. In the deal he will split time between the Bucks and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Wisconsin Herd]].{{cite news|title=Bucks Sign Frank Mason III and Cam Reynolds to Two-Way Contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/bucks-sign-frank-mason-iii-and-cam-reynolds-two-way-contracts|accessdate=July 27, 2019|work=NBA.com|date=July 26, 2019}} Reynolds did not ending up appearing in any games for the Bucks. ===Austin Spurs (2020–2021)=== On December 2, 2020, Reynolds was included in the training camp roster of the [[San Antonio Spurs]],{{cite web|title=Spurs announce 2020-21 training camp roster|url=http://nba.com/spurs/spurs-announce-2020-21-training-camp-roster|work=NBA.com|date=December 2, 2020|accessdate=December 2, 2020}} but was later waived by the Spurs on December 19 after appeared in one pre-season game.{{cite web|title=Spurs waive Cam Reynolds and Tyler Zeller|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-waive-cam-reynolds-and-tyler-zeller|date=December 19, 2020|website=NBA.com|accessdate=December 19, 2020}} He ultimately landed on the roster of the Spurs' G League affiliate, the [[Austin Spurs]], appearing in 14 games and averaging 16.1 points, 4.6 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 29.0 minutes.{{cite web|title=SPURS SIGN CAM REYNOLDS TO 10-DAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-sign-cam-reynolds-10-day-contract|date=March 26, 2021|website=NBA.com|accessdate=March 26, 2021}} ===San Antonio Spurs (2021)=== On March 26, 2021, the [[San Antonio Spurs]] signed Reynolds to a 10-day contract. ===Houston Rockets (2021)=== On May 14, 2021, the [[Houston Rockets]] signed Reynolds to a 10-day contract.{{cite web|title=Rockets Announce Roster Transactions|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-announce-roster-transactions|date=May 14, 2021|website=NBA.com|accessdate=May 14, 2021}} ===Dolomiti Energia Trento (2021–2022)=== On July 3, 2021, he has signed with [[Aquila Basket Trento|Dolomiti Energia Trento]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/dolomiti-energia-trentino-officially-signs-cameron-reynolds/|title=Dolomiti Energia Trentino officially signs Cameron Reynolds|last=|first=|date=July 3, to the [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] in exchange for [[Ky Bowman]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=February 21,
